video_title: NBA Finals Game 3 Preview: Can Spurs Make This A Series? + EPIC MSG Atmosphere

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' confidence after Game 1 and current missed opportunity mood
quotes.excerpt: the mood today was of missed opportunity. They understand that they've that it slipped through their fingers.
quotes.quote: After Game 1, the Spurs were very confident. They weren't beating their chest, but I think they were like, 'Yeah, we're not worried, we're fine.' The mood today was of missed opportunity. They understand that they've that it slipped through their fingers. Greg Popovich spoke to the team before they got on the plane, and he basically told them that. He's like, 'Don't think about one and two, don't think about the opportunities that you've had lost, think about the opportunity that you have.'

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs facing season-defining pressure in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: The pressure is on the Spurs here because they are essentially playing for their season tomorrow.
quotes.quote: The pressure is on the Spurs here because they are essentially playing for their season tomorrow. Now, the Knicks can't go in like they're playing with house money. I mean, Jaylen Brunson's tone was very serious. He's the tone setter for them and it was very serious, very matter of fact, very like, there's nothing to celebrate.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' dominance over Spurs throughout the season
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks are now four and one against the Spurs this year.
quotes.quote: The Knicks are now four and one against the Spurs this year. The one game they lost was the same thing, I think on December 30th or 31st. They're up big in the second half, they blow the lead, a couple missed shots at the end, they end up losing the game. The other two games of the regular season, the Knicks won comfortably, and they've controlled basically all five games at this point.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Castle's ankle injury and status
quotes.excerpt: Steph Castle spoke to the media today. Remember, tweaked his ankle in the fourth quarter.
quotes.quote: Steph Castle spoke to the media today. Remember, tweaked his ankle in the fourth quarter. He basically only played in a couple brief defensive special situations. Maybe one or two matchups later. He said that he was not sure how that ankle was going to feel when the adrenaline wore off, but he woke up yesterday and felt way better than he thought. Maybe he's lying, but he made it sound like he was fine.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox playing through ankle injury
quotes.excerpt: De'Aaron Fox has been playing with a high ankle sprain and they haven't put him on the injury report.
quotes.quote: De'Aaron Fox has been playing with a high ankle sprain and they haven't put him on the injury report because there's no question about whether he's playing. And De'Aaron Fox said about his ankle at this point, it is what it is, which I think is a good summation of that situation.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's role and offensive limitations
quotes.excerpt: As much as Victor Wembanyama is going to be the focal point, a lot of his offensive stuff has to come off of actions initiated by his guards.
quotes.quote: As much as Victor Wembanyama is going to be the focal point and in terms of like, weight of the world, it falls on his shoulders first, he's got the highest shoulders obviously. But a lot of his offensive stuff has to come off of actions initiated by his guards. It has to be off of their penetration.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's long-term goal to be the face of the league
quotes.excerpt: There's one guy who was very comfortable saying, 'I'm going to be the face of the league, I want to be the face of the league.' That's Victor Wembanyama.
quotes.quote: There's one guy who was very comfortable saying, 'I'm going to be the face of the league, I want to be the face of the league.' That's Victor Wembanyama. It's what he's wanted since he was a little kid, and it's what he has diligently worked towards since he was a little kid. All the sleeping 12 hours a day stuff, all the plyometric stuff he does to try to keep his body right, everything he's done has been geared around being the best player of all time.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' Hall of Fame trajectory
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns is two games away from eliminating any argument about whether he's a Hall of Famer.
quotes.quote: I'm not saying Karl-Anthony Towns is Stacey King, but Karl-Anthony Towns is about he's two games away from eliminating any argument about whether he's a Hall of Famer and he's probably going to be a Hall of Famer regardless the way he's played in this series.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' response to past criticism
quotes.excerpt: Now, people come back to me and give me all the congrats and congratulations and all the love for something they didn't help with.
quotes.quote: Now, people come back to me and give me all the congrats and congratulations and all the love for something they didn't help with and they told me to do the opposite. And that's how life always goes. Everyone's got an opinion until somebody actually does the work.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns had a superstar teammate force his way out of town while completely just roasting him on fire.
quotes.quote: The Wolves traded for Rudy Gobert because Karl-Anthony Towns wasn't good enough defensively to win. And listen, Karl-Anthony Towns had a superstar teammate force his way out of town while completely just roasting him on fire as publicly as you possibly could in Jimmy Butler and then Jimmy continued afterwards. So, Karl-Anthony Towns has taken a lot of criticism and it has not just been from media. It's been from, I don't know if he's talking about a coach. In the case of Jimmy and that was I believe what was it like 23 years old, like, I have a feeling that line is directed at one Jimmy Butler who has by the way, not won a title.
